e: Two workers are dead after a vehicle tire explodes at Navoi Mining and Metallurgical Company mine.
Ten modernist structures in Tashkent are designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
A gas explosion occurs at a filling station in Qashqadaryo Region, killing six people.
A court in Switzerland dismisses graft charges against former president Islam Karimov's daughter, Gulnara Karimova, citing her continued house arrest and inability to take part in the trial.
Tajikistani President Emomali Rahmon arrives in Uzbekistan for a state visit, during which the Tajikistan embassy is officially inaugurated in Tashkent.
President Mirziyoyev signs a decree to increase protection against women and children and apply harsher penalties against harassment, violence and pedophilia.
